approved: Moved that the Parliamentary Frameworks Legislation Amendment (Reviews) Bill 2026 be read a second time, proposing combined statutory reviews of the PWSS Act, MOP(S) Act and PBR Act within a broader review of Commonwealth parliamentary workplaces, with future PWSS Act and PBR Act reviews aligned from 23 March 2031 and every five years thereafter.

Declared that the Parliamentary Frameworks Legislation Amendment (Reviews) Bill 2026 and Northern Australia Infrastructure Facility Amendment Bill 2026 stood referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration.

Supported the Parliamentary Frameworks Legislation Amendment (Reviews) Bill 2026, which brings reviews of the PWSS Act, the Members of Parliament(Staff) Act 1984 and the Parliamentary Business Resources Act 2017 into consideration of parliamentary systems, while urging implementation of outstanding resourcing recommendations and consultation with the opposition and crossbench.

Argued that the Parliamentary Frameworks Legislation Amendment (Reviews) Bill 2026 would combine reviews of the Parliamentary Workplace Support Service Act 2023, Members of Parliament(Staff) Act 1984 and Parliamentary Business Resources Act 2017, while retaining flexibility for separate reviews and supporting fit-for-purpose parliamentary workplace standards; the bill was agreed to and ordered to be reported without amendment.

Moved the Parliamentary Frameworks Legislation Amendment (Reviews) Bill 2026, which would combine statutory reviews of parliamentary workplace legislation into a broader review and align future reviews of the Parliamentary Workplace Support Service Act 2023 and Parliamentary Business Resources Act 2017.

Moved to allocate 45 minutes for the Royal Commissions Legislation Amendment (Protections for Providing Information) Bill 2026 and 1 hour and 15 minutes for the Migration Amendment (2026 Measures No. 1) Bill 2026, with remaining stages to be put after the allotted times and divisions permitted after 4.30 pm.
Reported that the Parliamentary Frameworks Legislation Amendment (Reviews) Bill 2026 passed its second and third readings and was passed.
